Rules changed since d04061d, graded against the current text. The do: rule's new text adds no violation. "`if ..., do: ..., else: ...` stays on one line while its condition and both branches are plain" holds for haiku-1 line 85 and haiku-2 line 57 (both branches are names); "when both carry a computation of their own, write `do ... end`" does not reach sonnet-2 line 91, whose else is the plain entry.
